description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the AttendanceReportAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It is specifically designed to test API endpoints related to attendance reports, including retrieving a report and handling unsupported operations like delete or update.

classes.name: AttendanceReportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the TimeReportAPI, focusing on the 'getOne' API endpoint and verifying that delete and update operations throw not implemented exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of an attendance report using the API, with data provider supplying various test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides multiple test cases for the testGetOne method by reading test case data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling delete on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to get validation rules for delete operation throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that update operation on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that getting validation rules for update operation throws a 'not implemented' exception.
